name: Kuro Gyaru Bitch ni Shasei Kanri Saremashita? ~Aashi ni Ironna Kakkou Sasete Koufun Suru toka Kimoin Desu kedo~
original_name: 黒ギャルビッチに射精管理されました？ ～あーしにいろんな格好させて興奮するとかキモいんですけど～
source:
"Hey, what are you staring at me for, you suspicious old man?"

That innocent, adorable girl, Fuchinobe Sakura-chan, turned into such a stereotypical black gal... I didn't want to see this cruel reality.
Ah, if only her father had been just a little stricter with her, she wouldn't have turned into such a stereotypical gal....

Before I knew it, I'd impulsively started lecturing her. But if her parents aren't doing anything, someone around her has to stop her.

Then, she gave this sly grin, suddenly placed her hands on my chest, and said:

"You're saying all this stuff, but... Don't you just say it 'cause you wanna get laid? Fine, go on then. Show me this ‘fear of adults’ thing you're talking about."

‘D-Don't mess with me!’

Her provocative words pushed my anger to its peak, and reflexively...

translation:
“喂，你这个可疑老头，为什么一直盯着我看？”

那个天真可爱的女孩渊之边樱，竟变成了典型的黑辣妹……我不想面对这残酷现实。唉，要是她父亲当初再严格一点，她就不会变成这种典型辣妹了……

回过神来，我已经冲动地开始训斥她。但如果父母什么都不做，总得有人阻止她。

她露出狡猾笑容，突然把手放在我胸口，说道：

“你说这么多……不就是因为想上床吗？好啊，来吧。让我看看你说的‘大人的恐惧’到底是什么。”

“别、别把我当傻瓜！”

她挑衅的话让我的愤怒达到顶点，于是下意识地……
